entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system. This AGPL-3.0 context database provides observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated a 91% token reduction in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while integrating directly with Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Acting as an opinionated brain for Hermes, this project features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to synthesize answers with citations. It is designed for multi-user team environments through the use of scoped access controls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows compatible with over 25 LLM providers. It supports Python, Node.js, and Go clients, offering both hosted and self-hosted deployment options for agent memory.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library provides a FastAPI server and SDKs for building stateful agents with hybrid search capabilities. It serves as the upstream foundation for specialized Hermes wrappers, enabling prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli treats memory as a git repository, utilizing version control actions like commit and merge to manage a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms speeds across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond memory operations for Hermes Agents using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a dedicated Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os employs a seven-layer hierarchy, including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts, to manage persistent agent memory. It uses a 'Ground Truth' system to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context over other data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness uses outcome-gated promotion to improve context bundles and playbooks based on task success. It integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints to help agents navigate complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed DAG with full-text search metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing original message data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other major MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores data locally as human-readable YAML engrams for multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embedders, integrating directly with tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without the need for API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and vector search, accessible via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by using block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory solution that relies on SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. The project features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a reason for its selection. It supports embedded in-process operation by default and includes features for contradiction tracking and owner-scoping.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for coding agents.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn enables cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for a daemonless experience.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines semantic search with ranked graph traversal and BM25 full-text indexing. It supports automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the necessary context. This local-first MCP server integrates with Perseus Vault for SQLite-backed persistence, aiming to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory without external dependencies. It prioritizes high-value information through a 1-10 importance ranking system and utilizes BM25-first retrieval to surface relevant context.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This project provides a Git-backed workflow layer that tracks changes in durable Markdown files for coding agents. It establishes a shared lifecycle core to manage session starts, handoffs, and the migration of project data.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It features a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to ensure consistent state updates and semantic search capabilities.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across ten different blockchain families, including EVM and Solana. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services autonomously with minimal code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local Markdown files, cron jobs, and MCP configurations to provide agents with searchable local capability knowledge. It includes five specialized tools for artifact retrieval and supports automatic tool-routing note generation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents with tools for manual storage and searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and HTTP daemon execution modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term agent data.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory by connecting Hermes to a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A within repositories.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to enable autonomous task execution for Hermes Agent. It enforces software engineering principles like YAGNI and red-green-refactor TDD while integrating with coding harnesses such as Claude and Codex.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that allows Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes through a CLI. It supports design and prototyping workflows on macOS and Windows desktop applications.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets and features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It includes escrow and dispute resolution features to facilitate secure financial transactions between agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor for content refinement.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw automates the deduplication and quality improvement of skill libraries across multiple devices and team environments. It utilizes an Agentic Evolver to let skills evolve collectively while integrating with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local directory for agentskills.io-compatible agents. The skills are available as spec-conformant plugins designed to maintain context across sessions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 1,153 professional agent skills provided in plain markdown format for native use in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also includes ready-to-paste exports for other assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This project allows Hermes Agent to extract transcripts, search results, channel data, and playlists from YouTube. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and domain-specific lenses for its own tasks. It enhances reporting by providing findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular skill packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project scales and includes a review gate that evaluates specifications with a PASS/FAIL model.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically synchronizes source file edits back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory via file or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a dedicated CLI for managing tasks and cards to facilitate plan-approve-execute workflows.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills allow agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized capabilities for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository provides installation guides and skills formatted for the Agent Skills standard specifically in Portuguese. It serves as a localized resource for configuring and extending Hermes Agent within the Brazilian ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers official integration for FLUX image and video generation, including specialized skills for FLUX 3. It provides API documentation, code examples, and specific prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 models.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts existing code repositories and documentation into version-pinned, compliant skills for Node.js and Python environments. It ensures transparency by providing provenance through file and line number citations for all generated content.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with built-in recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, while supporting commerce through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides a local-first workflow language that uses a four-verb YAML specification to manage LLMs and tools. It enhances agent reliability by auditing permissions and costs before execution and generating tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard is a read-only code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and exploits. It validates findings through sandbox execution and deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit to provide verified statuses.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This community hub facilitates skill browsing and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an execution system where an agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores data locally in SQLite without cloud synchronization and connects to agents via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates for grounded execution. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for debugging and a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses three parallel sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports multiple languages including Rust and Go, featuring a tiered application process with a final approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of agent capabilities. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and supports automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle CVE-driven tasks spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language descriptions while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report any drift from official runtime profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill enables automated payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and interpreter selection for agents operating across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tools ensure file operations use environment-specific syntax and verify existing project-compatible Python runtimes.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API keys. It features tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with 85% of the payment routed to the winning wallet.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests and produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local OCR for PDFs and images to maintain privacy alongside video-to-text transcription capabilities. It also includes an e-commerce studio for batch material generation featuring brand overlays.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills via a hosted MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 platforms. It is built to support various agents including Claude, Cursor, and Hermes.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, to ensure reproducible environments. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to maintain parity with upstream releases.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool provides a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It features a built-in gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both standard deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Android.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository provides a Docker-based sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions of Hermes using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative deployment of Hermes Agent, including configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix or systemd EnvironmentFiles for secure secrets handling.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes and OpenClaw agents across Docker and Kubernetes clusters. It tracks per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps while providing access through REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It facilitates hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs without a graphical interface.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from USB drives or external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to deploy specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks. It features a researcher team that assesses insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other frameworks through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, scheduling, and monitoring spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web dashboard for managing parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It utilizes git worktrees for management and offers optional Docker or Podman sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture governed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features an MCP server for integration and automatically synchronizes the index whenever file changes occur.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token consumption and associated costs across various AI coding agents, including Hermes. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed debugging of agent interactions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and any provider that supports markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLIs directly. It supports multi-device synchronization, allowing users to monitor session details and account limits across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports human-readable identity handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for platforms like VS Code and Slack using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports multiple frameworks, including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during CLI workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that automatically switch between default and project-specific configurations based on the current folder. It enables the use of project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions to maintain context-specific agent behavior.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on agent configurations and tool descriptions without requiring API calls. It identifies issues like vague descriptions or missing stop conditions and supports SARIF and JSON outputs for CI/CD integration.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by monitoring local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and barge-in functionality. It operates locally without API keys, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup functions as a local-first skill that utilizes dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue. The tool prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for handling configurations across multiple CLI tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It serves as an all-in-one desktop controller for Windows, macOS, and Linux users.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local coworking application that integrates external agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while offering remote access via WebUI and Telegram. It distinguishes itself with built-in assistants capable of generating editable office documents such as PPT, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface runs the Hermes agent in-process and features a three-panel layout with an integrated workspace file browser. It is designed for both desktop and mobile use, utilizing secure SSH tunneling for remote accessibility.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience with Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive web dashboard that supports visual workflow building, Kanban boards, and scheduled jobs. It offers extensive connectivity, managing usage analytics and communication across ten platform channels including Slack, WhatsApp, and Discord.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It includes specialized tools for the Hermes ecosystem, such as a memory browser, an MCP catalog, and a Monaco-based file editor.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen different ACP-compatible agents into a single desktop or self-hosted environment. It is optimized for unattended code reviews by executing concurrent tasks within isolated git worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native macOS workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts, featuring an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access. It organizes agent activity through native views for Kanban boards, skills management, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering alongside dedicated modules for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges the active browser context with local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features 'Hermes Assist' for site-aware drafting and an opt-in controller that allows the agent to perform approved actions within browser tabs.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application designed specifically for iOS 18+ to drive self-hosted Hermes agents from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to provide mobile management of agent tasks, skills, and read-only memory analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines like OpenClaw, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking performance metrics like token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal, real-time tool call visualization, and system metrics to monitor the health of the Hermes AI agent stack.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live quota burn and analytics for 13 different agent sources without remote data uploads. It functions as a local cockpit for searching transcripts and browsing images generated during coding-agent sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP to provide a specialized interface for remote cloud computers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, focuses on session management and task organization through an integrated kanban board. Users can manage profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets within a terminal-based environment.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports spawning up to five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 for secure Telegram authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes Agent with local or cloud models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers alongside support for ComfyUI and TTS.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It offers dedicated management tools for tracking tasks, configuring cron jobs, and overseeing MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity logs and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories while maintaining read-only access to environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual store for one-click skill installations. The interface supports model switching and streaming SSE responses for multi-agent workflows.
